title.zh: Solana基金会推出机构级结算标准Solana DvP，获摩根大通参与设计
title.en: Solana基金会推出机构级结算标准Solana DvP，获摩根大通参与设计

current_state.zh: The Solana Foundation launched Solana DvP, an MIT-licensed open-source delivery-versus-payment settlement API for financial institutions, developed with J.P. Morgan's input on institutional settlement practices and already externally audited for real-funds use.
current_state.en: The Solana Foundation launched Solana DvP, an MIT-licensed open-source delivery-versus-payment settlement API for financial institutions, developed with J.P. Morgan's input on institutional settlement practices and already externally audited for real-funds use.
